_readme: Series with no free machine-readable source. Append [date, value] rows by hand; the dashboard charts any series with 2+ points. Never back-fill a value you haven't sourced.

war_risk_premium_gulf.label: Gulf war-risk hull premium, % of hull value per voyage
war_risk_premium_gulf.where: Lloyd's List, Reuters shipping desk, broker notes (Marsh, Howden)

eu_diesel.label: EU average diesel pump price, EUR/litre
eu_diesel.where: EU Weekly Oil Bulletin (energy.ec.europa.eu), published as XLSX

nondollar_oil_settlement.label: Share of oil trade settled outside USD, %
nondollar_oil_settlement.where: BIS, SWIFT RMB Tracker, Kpler/Vortexa reporting; estimates vary widely, so record the source per row

cips_volume.label: CIPS annual/monthly processed value, CNY trillion

open_weight_lag_months.label: Best open-weight model's lag behind the closed frontier, months
open_weight_lag_months.where: Epoch AI benchmarks hub, LMArena. Record the benchmark used.
